meta.title: Sportpalast Lindlar — Become your best self
meta.description: Premium fitness club in the Oberberg region: eGym, 30+ classes, sauna & wellness, physiotherapy. Become your best self – from €39.95/month.

hero.h1: Sportpalast Lindlar – premium fitness club in the Oberberg region. Become your best self.
hero.claim: Your path · your goal · our support

ankunft.subline: Light-flooded glass architecture with a view across the Oberberg hills.

entschluss.subline: You make the decision – we walk the path with you.

kraft_egym.subline: eGym, free weights and plate-loaded – training with a system.

kurse_energie.subline: More than 30 classes a week – movement that's contagious.

functional.subline: Athletic box and functional training for real performance.

regeneration.subline: 250 m² sauna & wellness – recovery as part of the training.

ankunft_ziel.subline: Two locations, one goal: your path, your success.

goals.heading: What are you training towards?
goals.subheading: No matter where you start – we'll get you there. Pick your goal and get going.

offers.heading: A palace for your training
offers.subheading: 2,000 m² of training space, 250 m² of wellness and a team that knows you.

egym.title: eGym & strength
egym.text: Smart strength training with eGym, free weights, plate-loaded machines and SECA body analysis.

kurse.title: 30+ classes
kurse.text: From Athletic to Lady Fitness and back fitness – more than 30 classes scheduled every week.

ausdauer.title: Cardio & Vibrafit
ausdauer.text: A modern cardio world and Vibrafit – full-body vibration training for fitness and metabolism.

functional.title: Functional & athletic box
functional.text: Open floors, battle ropes and the Athletic Box for functional training at your limit.

wellness.title: Sauna & wellness
wellness.text: 250 m² of sauna indoors & outdoors, Lounge & Café – recovery and free drinks included.

lady.title: Lady Fitness
lady.text: A protected training area exclusively for women – feel comfortable and grow strong.

personal.title: Personal training
personal.text: 1:1 coaching with your own coach – your plan, your goals, maximum progress.

physio.title: Physio & rehab sports
physio.text: Integrated physiotherapy and rehab sports (5 classes/week) for lasting health.

items.quote: State-of-the-art equipment, a team that cares and a view that makes every workout better. I love coming here every day.
items.name: Sandra K.

items.quote: The classes are incredible – over 30 a week, something for every level. And the sauna afterwards. Perfect.
items.name: Murat D.

items.quote: After my rehab I simply stayed at the club. Physio and training under one roof – exactly what I wanted.
items.name: Heike B.

membership.heading: Start your transformation
membership.text: All training types, 30+ classes, sauna, body analysis and access to both clubs – all included.
